newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares trim gains but still higher.
newsitem.headline: French shares trim gains but still higher.

text.p: French shares trimmed their gains in morning trade on Tuesday but remained firmly in positive territory after rising nearly one percent at the open.

Dealers described the increase as technical after Monday's nearly two percent fall and noted that volume was modest. "It's a technical move after yesterday's big drop," said one. "The market is still very nervous about the possibility of a rise in rates by the Bundesbank as well as in the U.S."
* CAC-40 index was up 13.82, or 0.46 percent, at 3,006.23 at 0851 GMT.
* CAC-40 Aug futures 3,013 vs 2,997 at Mondays close.
